# Alpha Repo

## Project

Alpha is the primary service repository for the workspace-trio test fixture.
Used by Phase 30 workspace orchestration tests.

### Constraints

- POSIX bash + Node.js .mjs hooks.
- No runtime dependencies beyond bash and jq.

## Technology Stack

Minimal test harness with git skill.

## Conventions

- Follow the git workflow skill for all commits.
- Use imperative mood in commit messages.
- Branch from main for all feature work.

## Architecture

Standard conjure harness layout with git skill.
